x: Malto), David Laing, Bill Bowers, Dick Towndrow, Len Herbert, "Quack," (Quackenbos), Albert Chetland, Dick Dumbrill, "Megaphone Man" Cook, Bill Snell, R.S.M.

Albert Chetland still enjoys a spin over the Common, and writes of the "Espirit de Corps" silently running through the Club. Len Marchant led his station to victory in an Inter-Allied meeting at Birmingham.
Albert Chetland, another enthusiastic veteran, writes upon receiving the "Belgravian": "Many thanks for the Glad Tidings—I can almost see the postscript, 'You have not paid your subscription!'"
